### Constants / Configuration

- `FIELDS_RECURSION_LIMIT = 3` — Max depth for recursive field tree extraction (`models/base_import.py:32`)
- `FUZZY_MATCH_DISTANCE = 0.2` — Threshold for fuzzy field mapping similarity (`models/base_import.py:222`)
- `ERROR_PREVIEW_BYTES = 200` — Bytes of bad data to include in error messages (`models/base_import.py:33`)
- `DEFAULT_IMAGE_TIMEOUT = 3` — Seconds timeout for image URL fetches (`models/base_import.py:34`)
- `DEFAULT_IMAGE_MAXBYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024` — Max bytes (10 MB) for remote image downloads (`models/base_import.py:35`)
- `DEFAULT_IMAGE_REGEX = r"^(?:http|https)://"` — Pattern to detect URLs in image fields (`models/base_import.py:36`)
- `DEFAULT_IMAGE_CHUNK_SIZE = 32768` — Bytes per chunk for streaming image downloads (`models/base_import.py:37`)
- `IMAGE_FIELDS = ["icon", "image", "logo", "picture"]` — Field names treated as images for URL fetching (`models/base_import.py:38`)
- `FILE_TYPE_DICT` — MIME type → handler mapping for CSV, XLS, XLSX, ODS (`models/base_import.py:82-92`)
- `EXTENSIONS` — File extension → handler mapping (derived from FILE_TYPE_DICT) (`models/base_import.py:93-96`)
- `BOM_MAP` — UTF BOM signatures for encoding detection (`models/base_import.py:40-45`)

## Dependencies

### Internal

- **ir.model** — Model metadata for fields_get, load, relation mapping
- **ir.model.fields** — Field definitions and importability flags
- **base_import.mapping** — Cached column-to-field mappings for repeated imports
- **res.users** — For image import permission check (_can_import_remote_urls)

### External

- **chardet** — Auto-detect file encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, CP1252, etc.)
- **xlrd** — Read legacy XLS (Excel 97-2003) format; optional if openpyxl available
- **openpyxl** — Read/write XLSX (Excel 2007+) format; preferred over xlrd for modern Excel
- **odfpy** — Open Document Format (ODS) parsing via ODSReader wrapper
- **PIL (Pillow)** — Image format detection for binary field validation
- **requests** — HTTP GET for image URL downloads with timeout/maxbytes limits
- **lxml** — XML parsing for xlsx.ET (etree) in xlrd.xlsx module
- **difflib** — Fuzzy string matching for field name suggestions (SequenceMatcher)
- **psycopg2** — PostgreSQL driver for transaction control (already installed by Odoo)

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Pure utility** — Does not belong to any business component; used across all modules that need bulk data import
- **Boundary code** — HTTP endpoint accepts file uploads; parses and validates before delegating to ORM load
- **Extensibility hook** — Base.get_import_templates() allows any model to provide custom import templates (e.g., sale.order imports)
- **Format-agnostic** — Abstraction over chardet/xlrd/openpyxl/odf allows adding new formats without changing core logic
- **Image handling** — Special-cases icon/image/logo/picture fields for URL-to-binary conversion with timeout/size limits
- **Mapping persistence** — Caches column→field mappings to avoid repeated manual mapping for same third-party source
